description: Send a Magic Reach message. Requires confirm set to SEND. Supports Lexical email editor content via emailLexicalContent, or emailBodyText which MCP converts to content.root. Before offering this action or requesting its inputs, check business permissions. FREE businesses cannot use this tool, regardless of individual feature rows. Call check_business_tool_access before collecting inputs. Show any grace-period warning and verified resubscribe link before continuing, and never proceed when access is blocked.

communityId.description: Nas.com business (community) ID. Use an ID returned by list_businesses or another Nas.com tool; never invent one.

confirm.description: Explicit confirmation for this write. Pass the exact literal this tool requires (for example DELETE) only after the user approves the action.

content.description: Raw Magic Reach editor content. For Lexical, pass { root: ... }.

emailBodyText.description: Plain email body text. MCP converts paragraphs into Lexical content.root for Magic Reach.

emailLexicalContent.description: Lexical editor content for the Magic Reach email. Pass either { root: ... } or the raw Lexical root node.

emailSubject.description: Email subject alias for title. MCP forwards this to LPBE as title.

items.description: Canonical Magic Reach bucket identifier from the `bucket` field returned by list_magic_reach_buckets; do not use `name` or `displayName`.

sentPlatforms.description: Channels to send the message on.

name: send_magic_reach_message
title: Send Magic Reach Message
